issue_context.title: Bluetooth tester application should be able return L2CAP ECFC credits on demand
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Some qualification tests require that IUT is capable on returning credits only on on-demand from upper tester.

**Impact**
Qualification tests are not passing consistently which is affecting BLE qualification.

review_comments:
That the ownership of the reference `buf` depends on the return value of this callback is such an unexpected contract. It's not documented on `struct bt_l2cap_chan_ops :: recv`. Are we sure that it's like this? Can you confirm, @joerchan? I would expect either that the reference `buf` is always moved or always borrowed into this function.

By "Moved", I mean caller gave away ownership by calling and never uses this copy of the reference again not free it and must assume it has already been `net_buf_unref`ed.

By "Borrowed" I mean caller assumes it has ownership of the reference when the control returns and this function has to copy the reference (i.e. by net_buf_ref) if it wants it to live beyond this function.
It is quite clear to me. With EINPROGRESS netbuf needs to be returned either via bt_l2cap_chan_recv_complete() or with unref (eg upon disconnection).
I would avoid the word "user" here. Can we say "This function gains ownership of reference `buf` if it returns -EINPROGRESS."?
